Reviewed at this commit: line 42 of docker-compose.yml reads `image: postgres:12-alpine`. The PostgreSQL Global Development Group lists 12 as unsupported: its final release was on November 21, 2024, so it receives no further bug or security fixes. A database image tag or managed engine_version on this line runs unsupported software. (PostgreSQL versioning policy, https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/).
